# geometry result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geometryResult`](gmeow-geometryResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geometryResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The [`Geometry`](../classes/gmeow-Geometry.md) result of a coordinate observation — a point, line, or polygon expressed as WKT or GeoJSON. The reference frame is carried on the observation and propagates to the result via the existing property chain.
